lesson.rationale: The failure occurs at an equality boundary: a check expecting the quantity to be admitted when it equals capacity instead rejects it. This commonly indicates an exclusive comparison or an off-by-one condition. When a requirement includes equality, inspect the boundary operator and add focused tests for below, exactly at, and above the limit.
lesson.summary: Translate inclusive requirements into inclusive comparisons, and test both sides of the boundary plus the equality case.
lesson.when: Use this whenever a rule involves limits, capacities, ranges, quotas, indexes, or thresholds whose wording may include or exclude the endpoint.
